clauses.zh: 以靛蓝为主色，唯一醒目的橙红落在插入书页的书签。
clauses.en: Use indigo as the main color, with orange-red as the sole prominent accent at the bookmark tucked into the pages.

clauses.zh: 将细节集中在书签、页缘与指尖，外围保持疏朗。
clauses.en: Concentrate detail at the bookmark, page edges, and fingertips and keep the surrounding area sparse.

clauses.zh: 用粗细分明的靛蓝线条与平面墨块塑形，米白纸面保留轻微纤维。
clauses.en: Build forms with indigo lines of distinct weights and flat ink shapes over lightly fibrous off-white paper.

clauses.zh: 以一本摊开的图书与一位读者的手为主体，呈现读者用一枚书签标记阅读位置。
clauses.en: Feature an open book and a reader's hand, depicting the reader placing a bookmark to mark their place.

clauses.zh: 场景为雨后社区图书馆的阅读桌，后景只交代必要内容。
clauses.en: Set the image in a reading table in a neighborhood library after rain, using only essential background detail.

clauses.zh: 从画幅上方的靛蓝标题读到翻开的书页，最后停在橙红书签上。
clauses.en: Lead the eye from the indigo title at the top to the open pages, then settle on the orange-red bookmark.

clauses.zh: 标题置于画幅上方，使用可读的靛蓝字形。
clauses.en: Place the title at the top of the image in legible indigo lettering.
